lines.t: Verse 1]
Before the breath inside my lungs
Before my heart had learned to run
You traced the lines of who I’d be
In hidden light, in mystery
I wandered through what I became
A fractured echo of Your name
Dust and fire in my chest
Trying to feel what I suppressed
Then You called me out of silence
Like the dawn splits open night
Every piece of who I was
Started turning toward the light
you bring me life
From the dirt You formed my story
Now Your breath is in my fight
YahuShua, my Savior
You knew me from the start
Now I’m breathing in Your rhythm
Like You’re beating in my heart
I was living half-alive
Wearing truth I’d falsified
Every mirror showed a ghost
Of the man I needed most
But Your voice cut through the blur
Like a wound that had to hurt
Still it healed what I denied
Now I feel it deep inside
Every sorrow has a purpose
Every tear has found its place
What was broken in the dark
Now is shining in Your grace
you make me whole
Every breath a new beginning
Every scar a piece made gold
YahuShua, my Savior
You rewrote all my wrongs
Now I’m standing in the freedom
I was searching for so long
You formed me from the dust and pain
Spoke beauty through my shame
Every loss and every scar
Still You loved me as I am
Now I’m held within Your hands
Not by force, but by Your love
Even in my lowest place
You were reaching from above
Now I feel what I was made
Every heartbeat tells the story
Of a life no grave could take
YahuShua, my Savior
You’re the truth that set me free
Now I’m fully awakened
To the life You breathed in me
I was formed
I was known
Not alone
I’m Your own
Through the dark
Through the flame
And now I will never let go
